newsitem.title: USA: Exxon to increase share repurchases.
newsitem.headline: Exxon to increase share repurchases.

text.p: Exxon Corp said Tuesday it intends to increase its share repurchases, adding the action is expected to result in a gradual reduction in common stock outstanding.
The company set no stock repurchase target, saying the purchases may be discontinued at any time. Exxon may make purchases in both the open market and through negotiated transactions, it said.
Exxon said it has purchased 550 million treasury shares at a cost of $18.8 billion since 1983, representing 32 percent of stock outstanding at the beginning of 1983.
Since 1991, the company said, Exxon's common stock outstanding has remained unchanged unchanged at the current level of about 1.24 billion shares, on a pre-split basis.
Exxon said it will continue to report its treasury share purchases in its quarterly earnings report.
